name: 会話に共有する準備リスト
prompt:
Create a faithful, compact mobile conversation-post image based primarily on the Native Japanese preview reference. Preserve the exact Japanese content and authored order. Keep the canvas aspect ratio exactly 390:206 and show only this single white post, without channel chrome or surrounding app UI.

Match the native preview's geometry closely: pale mint circular avatar at the upper-left with the dark green 山 initial; bold dark author name 「山田 はるか」 beside it; muted gray time 「14:45」 aligned on the same top row at the right. Place the heading 「次の相談までに考えること」 beneath the author row, then exactly four short black bullet rows:
・参考になる事例を集める
・どの方法で進めるか話し合う
・話し合いの流れを決める
・下書きを作成する

Correction from v001: move the entire content group upward by about 10 logical pixels to align with the native preview, and tighten the vertical gaps between the heading and bullets and between bullet rows. Keep the bullet rows compact and evenly spaced like the native preview, with the final row ending comfortably above the bottom edge. Preserve the existing left alignment, font hierarchy, line breaks, and horizontal positions; do not enlarge the text or avatar. Use a clean flat white surface without shadows or texture.

This post contains no hyperlink, so all text remains dark except the muted-gray timestamp and the avatar's dark-green initial. Do not add blue text, links, pictures, reactions, extra controls, dividers, or any other UI. The original Slack screenshot is context for the four-item checklist only; the native preview controls the Japanese wording, layout, avatar, color, and spacing.
reviewNotes: 第2版を目視。作者・時刻・見出しと4項目すべての日本語を保持し、余計なUI・青文字はない。native 390x206 preview比で作者/アバター/見出しと先頭箇条書き2行は約9〜13論理px低く、3行目は約3px低い一方、4行目は概ね揃うため縦方向の配分と間隔に残差。2回の上限試行を保存しneeds-correctionのまま後続IDへ進む。所有者承認・ネイティブ編集・実動作は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
